records.title: PRISM: Personalized Recommendation via Information Synergy Module
records.reason: PRISM is a personalized multimodal sequential-recommendation method; the full paper’s efficiency analysis reports recommendation-model training time and memory, not LLM inference.

records.title: Scalable Neural Pushbroom Architectures for Real-Time Denoising of Hyperspectral Images Onboard Satellites
records.reason: The full text studies satellite hyperspectral-image denoising with line-wise Mamba inference, power scaling and fault tolerance; no language-model inference contribution is established.

records.title: TA-Prompting: Enhancing Video Large Language Models for Dense Video Captioning via Temporal Anchors
records.reason: TA-Prompting adds temporal anchors to improve dense video-event localization/caption quality. Although it is a VideoLLM, the inspected primary text does not establish a token/memory/latency reduction; its contribution is task quality and temporal alignment.

records.title: RMAAT: Astrocyte-Inspired Memory Compression and Replay for Efficient Long-Context Transformers
records.reason: RMAAT combines astrocyte-inspired memory compression/replay for long-context Transformers and reports Long Range Arena results, but the inspected experiments do not establish LLM-specific generation/KV-cache/serving gains.

records.title: Data-interactive mamba driven SAR-optical fusion cloud removal
records.reason: The title/source metadata identify Mamba-based SAR-optical image fusion/cloud removal, not LLM inference.
